required_capabilities: Create Slab Type (×1); Replace Element Type (×1); Inspect Project (×1); Query Materials (×1)
instruction: Create a concrete intermediate-floor composite finished with parquet, with three layers, top->bottom: (1) 15 mm timber parquet finish, (2) 60 mm cement screed, (3) a 200 mm reinforced-concrete structural slab (the Core). An intermediate floor slab already exists within the exterior-wall footprint. Change this existing slab to use the newly created composite. Do not modify the slab's boundary, elevation, thickness positioning, or the existing exterior walls.

slabs.label: existing slab switched to the new composite
